title: Covering design C(28,17,4)
statement: Find 17-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 28} such that every 4-subset lies in some block, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 20 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 17 distinct points from 1..28 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(28,17,4) = 20 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-25 (before it 21); read 6 Nov 2026

provenance.revision: repository read on the date given

score: the number of blocks (smaller is better)
quantavane_note: our object is the best known entry of the source table
